ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High ratio of high-intensity light-gray/white pixels (approx. 80%) to low-intensity black pixels (approx. 20%) localized at the periphery.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous light-intensity central region; low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous boundary along the leading and trailing edges, with discrete dark pixel clusters concentrated around the median notch and extending toward the mid-lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel-depth-to-width ratio indicating an acute internal angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by numerous small-scale peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast brown and white pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) localized at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of a prominent, dark, unaligned diagonal linear disruption on the left lobe surface, and a smaller vertical linear mark adjacent to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustation (barnacles) on distal tips; distinct diagonal rake marks on the left ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Low-density dark stippling/mottling distributed across the high-intensity light regions of the fluke lobes.
